description.narrative: The projects development objective is to assist the Government of Samoa (GOS) in its efforts to support the relocation and rehabilitation of communities living in the island of Upolu affected by the tsunami of September 29, 2009, through the provision of improvedinfrastructure access to relocation sites; enhanced transport infrastructure, and assistance to local communities to address futurenatural disasters.
